item.title: Rushcliffe MP welcomes the UK rejoining Erasmus Plus programme
item.description: Rushcliffe MP James Naish has welcomed the government’s announcement that the UK will rejoin the EU’s £23 billion Erasmus Plus programme from January 2027, building on agreements secured at the UK-EU Summit in May.
